---
title: "Wasserstein stability and ODE tracking for Markov-driven stochastic approximation with contractive memory"
author:
  - name: "Jordan Simbananiye"
    affiliations:
      - name: "University College London (UCL) - CCMI CDT"
date: last-modified
abstract: |
  We study Markov-driven stochastic approximation with persistent, contractive
  memory. A trajectory coupling of the driving chain lifts to geometric
  Wasserstein contraction of the augmented kernel, yielding an invariant law
  and quantitative convergence. Weighted kernel perturbations give Lipschitz
  dependence of the invariant law and log-Lipschitz parameter regularity of
  centred Poisson solutions. Under quadratic drift, parameter stability,
  bounded increments and logarithmically corrected gain summability, a
  Poisson--martingale decomposition yields tracking of the stationary mean-field
  ODE. Adam adaptation in MCMC provides a motivating application: stationary
  EMA memories exist under weaker frozen moment assumptions, and the Adam
  field contains a covariance correction at Robbins--Monro roots.
---
